descFull: AI 小说写作桌面软件：长篇小说与网文，从设定、蓝图到正文、审稿、定稿；支持拆解仿写、续写、改写小说，可导入写作 Skill（如去 AI 味）。本地优先，模型需自行配置。Free, open-source AI novel writing app for long novels and web fiction: imitate, continue, and rewrite novels; import writing skills. Local-first; no model bundled (DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Ollama). Windows & macOS.
